# What the fuzz image installs for its Python 3.12 (see Dockerfile): the
# pyinstaller base-builder's install_python.sh pins, the atheris its
# "atheris>=2.3.0" resolves to, everything pyinstaller pulls in on Linux, and
# the coverage.py a coverage build's stub imports inside every frozen target
# (a dev dependency, so build.sh's lockfile install does not bring it).
# Installed with --require-hashes, so every one is checked against its SHA-256.
